set.name: heldout_repoatlas
set.description: Held-out set on RepoAtlas's own source at commit 7371990 (the repoatlas package without the vendored project_index and the benchmark question files, plus tests/ without fixtures): 8 questions, where x2, config, flow, impact, behaviour, why, tests. Questions and gold as written by the retrieval research agent; gold re-anchored to 7371990.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by the retrieval research agent by reading the RepoAtlas source of its research snapshot; for this set every fact was re-read at commit 7371990 by the measurement agent, its locators re-pointed to the same code (3 facts restated where the code was restructured, see each fact's review), and each source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before scoring (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: retrieval research agent (round-3 research), after its prototype was built and before the prototype was run on this corpus
provenance.gold_reviewed_by: measurement agent (round-3 measurement step): every fact re-read and re-anchored to commit 7371990; no fact added or removed, question wording unchanged
provenance.caveat: held out from RepoAtlas design, not unseen: the search track ran it during development and reports it was not used for tuning
provenance.original_file: retrieval_track/heldout.json (research scratch, not in the repository)
